description: Service companies in the Nadveo catalog, filtered by country (ISO code, e.g. AE), city, district, service and name, best first. Each has its districts (main: fast arrival; secondary: next day or a call-out fee), "from" prices, the next free day and clients' rating.

category.description: The kind of service, e.g. hvac.maintenance, hvac.repair, repair.electrical, repair.plumbing.

city.description: The city, e.g. Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah (part of the name is enough).

country.description: ISO 3166 code, e.g. AE, MX, ID, TH, VN.

district.description: The client's district in that city, e.g. "JLT", "Dubai Marina", "Al Nahda" (part of the name is enough).

service.description: Older form of category for air conditioning: maintenance = hvac.maintenance, repair = hvac.repair, installation = hvac.installation.

trade.description: hvac = air conditioning and heating; repair = electrical, plumbing and other repairs. Matches the services a company offers, not only its main trade.

title: Find a company
